🆕 New Listing (Posted: May 1, 2026)

【POSTPONED】The Hanno City Eco-Tour Guide Training Course has been postponed. A new schedule will be announced.

This course is for people who want to become eco-tour guides active in the community. You will learn eco-tour experiences, guiding techniques, and operational methods through hands-on practice.

【Originally Scheduled Dates】
May 30 (Sat) 9:00 a.m.–2:10 p.m. Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry Conference Room
June 7 (Sun) 9:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. Hanno City Museum Kittus

Eligibility: People who live, work, or study in Hanno City, or who belong to an eco-tour implementation organization, and can attend both sessions in principle
Capacity: 10 people (first come, first served)
Fee: ¥1,000 per person (covers materials, insurance, etc.). Payment due at check-in on the first day
Application Deadline: May 23 (Fri)
How to Apply: Email hannokanko@gmail.com or phone 042-980-5051 to contact the Hanno Eco-Tourism Promotion Council Secretariat (Okumusashi Hanno Tourism Association)
